title: From Global to Local: Social Bias Transfer in CLIP

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring demographic disparity via KL-divergence of Retrieval@k and downstream performance metrics (VQA accuracy, CIDEr), alongside spurious correlations using MaxSkew@k, Directional Bias Amplification (DBA), and LIC.
Evaluating performance disparity and spurious correlations across lighter and darker skintone images in pre-trained image-text retrieval, visual question answering, and image captioning tasks.
Assessing demographic disparity and harmful stereotype associations across different racial and ethnic groups using MaxSkew@k and retrieval disparities on annotated facial image datasets.
Measuring demographic disparity and spurious stereotype associations across age demographics using pre-training retrieval metrics and downstream task evaluations.
